Geospiders S4 in Lahai-Roi gravitate towards places bathed in Lumiglow where they perform <color=Light>Lumiglow Revelation</color>. Once the revelation is complete, the Lumiglow fades, revealing the hidden objects inside.

In Lahai-Roi, Zip Zaps can sense any nearby immobilized Spacetrek Explorer and release an <color=Thunder>Electric Shock</color> to restore the Explorer to normal operating status. Additionally, Zip Zaps can detect defective power lines in their immediate surroundings, and can release an <color=Thunder>Electric Shock</color> to re-energize the line.

In Lahai-Roi, Mining Reindeer can sense nearby Soliskin sealed inside special Luxites. The reindeer can fire a sustained <color=Thunder>laser beam</color> to break the rock's outer shell, allowing you to free the trapped Soliskin.

In the frostlands, Glommoths can sense and shatter massive ice formations. Shattering the ice reveals paths and objects once sealed by the cold. Glommoths can also interact with Soliskin hiding within caves. Look for glimmering caves where the Soliskin hide, then use the Glommoth Projection to uncover the secrets they conceal.

Around the Dimmr Plains, Voidwing Moth uses its wings to scatter the Soliskin Puffs unique to the Dimmr Plains, within which hidden treasures may be found. Additionally, in certain areas with residual Voidmatter contamination, Voidwing Moth's power may be utilized to disperse the residual Voidmatter that shrouds what's hidden within.
